crossRefs.note: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth; and these were her sons…
Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Son of Hezron, descendant of Judah

people.name: Ephah
people.line: Caleb's concubine and mother of three sons.

people.name: Gazez
people.line: Son of Caleb and his concubine Ephah.

people.name: Haran
people.line: A descendant of Caleb, son of Caleb's concubine Ephah.

people.name: Moza
people.line: Son of Caleb by his concubine Ephah

translations.web: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.
translations.bsb: Caleb’s concubine Ephah was the mother of Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran was the father of Gazez.
translations.kjv: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
translations.asv: And Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez; and Haran begat Gazez.
